One attention-only block, d=8, 2 heads: head A reads N via weights 100:10:1, head B reads emitted bits via weights 2^k with '=' as a mass sink; argmax compares r with 2^k. No LayerNorm/MLP.

d=4, 2 heads, attention only: one log-weight channel is key for both heads and query for the sink; '=' value 1/2 makes the sink supply the trial weight 2^k; rank-one head reads the sign of N-S-2^k+1/2.
e03 with the position table cut to the 11 positions actually fed to the model.
e04 with token value and position channels concatenated rather than added, and a head that reads only OUT.
Ablation of e05: silencing key OFF lowered from 20 to 2, leaking attention between digits and bits.
Margin sweep on e05: silencing key OFF = 5.
Margin sweep on e05: silencing key OFF = 10.
Robustness of e05: 0.1% multiplicative Gaussian noise on every nonzero weight.
Robustness of e05: 0.01% multiplicative Gaussian noise on every nonzero weight.
Ablation of e05: '=' keeps fixed log-mass 0 rather than a mass that varies with position, so head B's denominator is no longer 256.
Ablation of e05: '=' value set to 0, so the sink no longer supplies the trial weight 2^k and every bit is tested against zero.
Ablation of e05: head B disconnected, so the model has no memory of emitted bits or any threshold and always compares N with 0.
e05 plus a stock final LayerNorm: the head reads the difference OUT - SINK, whose sign LayerNorm preserves.
Full stock block (ln1, attention, ln2, MLP) at d=10: equal-norm zero-mean embeddings make the pre-attention LayerNorm an exact identity; MLP is a no-op.
Original architecture and hyperparameters (d=64, 4 heads, 3 layers, d_ff=256): the e15 circuit sits in block 1 and all other blocks and MLPs are no-ops.

All-integer weights, d=13, 13 heads, attention only: each head is a wire from one position, place values 200,20,2,-256..-4 sit in W_o and the threshold table sits in the head. No logs or square roots.
Robustness of e17: 0.1% multiplicative Gaussian noise on every nonzero weight, for comparison with e09.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the place values in W_o only.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the digit values in the token embedding only.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the output head, including the threshold table, only.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the per-head value gains in W_v only.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the position embedding only; its one-hot multiplies the threshold table and its constant sets every query.
Fragility map of e17: 0.1% noise on the attention query and key matrices only.
Score sweep on e17: smallest clean integer attention scores, HIT=6 and FALLBACK=3.
Score sweep on e17: HIT=16 and FALLBACK=8.
Score sweep on e17: HIT=20 and FALLBACK=10.
One head with zero query and key: a gated-ReLU MLP computes signed place values per position, uniform attention averages them, and the head's threshold table divides by the known p+1.
e28 with the gate leak fixed: GATE raised above 128*9 so a bit unit stays off when a digit 8 or 9 sits at another position.
Contrast model that ignores emitted bits: each bit is a position-gated square wave of N made from 1004 ReLU ramps, showing what autoregression saves.
e30 with the attention scale fixed (query multiplied by sqrt(dh)): feedback-free square waves from 1004 ReLU ramps, showing what autoregression saves.
Precision of e05: every weight rounded to 3 decimal places.
Precision of e05: every weight rounded to 2 decimal places.
e05 with the U channel in units of bits: positions hold integer ranks 7..1 and ln 2 appears only as a scale in W_q.
Precision of e34: every weight rounded to 2 decimal places, for comparison with e33.
Precision of e34: every weight rounded to 1 decimal place.
e35 with the silencing offset lowered from 20 to 10 bits.
e35 with the silencing offset lowered from 20 to 15 bits.
Final model, 119 params: one attention-only block with d=4 and 2 heads implementing trial subtraction; every weight is a literal with at most two decimals and bit ranks are integers.
